_description: BACKUP: These patterns were removed from the active pattern file because they will never fire. Each pattern has a canonical_candidate that is adjacent (within 1 cell diagonally/orthogonally) to one of its canonical_stars. The solver already forces such cells empty via the basic adjacency rule (no two stars may be adjacent), so the entanglement pattern adds no new information. The applyTripleRule() function in src/logic/entanglements/matcher.ts explicitly checks for this and skips such candidates. See the adjacency safety check around line 257 in matcher.ts.
_reason_invalid: canonical_candidate is adjacent (|rowDiff|<=1 AND |colDiff|<=1) to at least one canonical_star, making the forced-empty deduction redundant with the standard Star Battle adjacency rule
